_note: The family builder's limits (the admin page's Content tab › New family, and npm run content -- new-family / preview / variations; docs/CONTENT_PIPELINE.md). Every limit the builder keeps is here, not in code: how many parts a family may make, how many jobs run at once, what a name and an id may be, how many parts a preview makes, when it warns. Shape settings' ranges are in formulas.json (families.<kind>.shapeSettings); the real names a name is checked against in real-names.json.

families._note: maxVariants: above it the summary warns (a family that big is slow to build and check, and floods its slot); hardMaxVariants: above it nothing is made. maxValuesPerSetting: how many values one setting may list (from, to, step counts too).

names._note: A family's name: its length, the characters it may have (letters, digits, a hyphen, one space), and how close to a real make, model or part brand (real-names.json) it may be — similarity is 0 (nothing alike) to 1 (the same, after lower-casing and reading 0 as o, 1 as i…): at or over it, refused. shortWholeWord: real names this short or shorter only count as a whole word ("OZ" refuses "OZ Line", not "Ozone"); fuzzyFrom: real names at least this long are matched fuzzily (by similarity), shorter ones only as written or as they sound (Spool isn't Spoon). suggestions: how many Suggest names offers at a time.

parts._note: What suggested names are made from: a first part for the kind, then an ending (or a number). Made up, in the style of the families there are (Streetline, Mesh-10, Aerofoil, Coldcore…).

ids._note: A family's id: made from its name (lower case, the hyphen and space left out or made _), unique among families, engines and the parts there are.

jobs._note: Build and check run as jobs on the server (tools/content/jobs.mjs). maxRunning: jobs at once (previews alongside each other; a job that writes files has them to itself, the others that write wait their turn); maxQueued: waiting at most; keepFinished: finished jobs kept to look at; timeoutMinutes: a job running longer is stopped (and everything it did put back).

preview._note: Preview: the parts it makes models for when none are picked (the smallest, the largest, one in the middle, and one of each shape), at most maxParts; maxCars: the cars it fits a fitted kind's models to.

warnings._note: When the summary warns: crowdedTier — a slot that would have at least this many parts at one tier (the shop's list gets long); nearStats — another family's part whose every stat is within this share of the new one's (the same part, really); nearShape — a design whose shape settings are all within this share of their range of another family's of the kind.

variations._note: Make variations: at most this many new families at once, each a draft, each previewed before anything is made.
